limitations: Two new documents from one company; not proof of cross-industry generalization or statistical superiority.
B/C have identical prepared records and two repetitions each. A reads the same raw documents once.
Same model and router policy; actual reasoning per request is recorded, upstream cache warmth is uncontrolled.
All failed attempts and unknown usage remain counted. Ingestion preparation is separate from analysis.
Deterministic rendering smoke alone does not prove model adoption or financial correctness. Review actual answers, calculations and figures.
Developer-reviewed, not blinded: arithmetic/download/replay checks are deterministic; interpretation and visual assessments are qualitative, not independent expert scoring.
